verdict.rationale: Firstbase offers a registered agent service in all 50 states, so service-of-process alerting is a fair question for this product. The evidence never documents immediate or priority notification when a lawsuit or legal notice is served. The general mail scanning and compliance dashboard are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, a lawsuit or other time-sensitive legal notice triggers an immediate notification rather than waiting on a mail batch
